name: pressure_tank_autonomous
description: Fully autonomous pressure-vessel FEM — closed flat-capped tank with mounting feet; the prompt states the service context (6 bar internal air/water pressure, bolted at the feet) and the agent must derive the whole load model: the sealed INNER skin as the pressure surface (cavity region + pressure_mpa), the feet as fixed supports, declared in spec.load_cases; foot bolt holes in spec.features. fem declares NOTHING (use_parent_fallbacks).

stages.prompt:
Closed pressure vessel / compressed-air receiver tank (steel, S235), parametric.

Frame: tank axis along Z, bottom face on the XY plane (z = 0), centred in X and Y. mm.
- Body: a hollow vertical cylinder — outer dia 80 (r = 40), total outer height exactly 120 (z = 0..120).
- Ends: flat welded plates, ~3 mm thick each — a bottom cap sealing z = 0 and a top cap sealing z = 120. The result is a closed cylindrical tank, no domes.
- Wall thickness ~3 mm everywhere (shell + both end plates) — the interior is a sealed cavity of roughly Ø74 dia and ~114 inner height. Easiest robust construction: an Ø80 solid cylinder cut out by a concentric Ø74 inner cylinder from z = 3 to z = 117, which leaves the 3 mm shell plus the 3 mm top and bottom plates automatically.
- 3 mounting feet welded at the bottom: vertical lugs ~18 wide × 6 thick × ~20 tall, spaced 120 deg around the base circle (r ~ 34), each with ONE dia-6.5 through-hole along Z centred in the lug (bolt holes, open top to bottom).
- No other attachments — no nozzle, no boss, no openings anywhere. The interior cavity must stay completely sealed — do not cut any hole into the shell or end plates.
- The result must be a single watertight VALID solid centred on the origin.

SERVICE CONTEXT — derive the structural model yourself: this is a welded-sealed compressed-air receiver holding ~6 bar INTERNAL pressure against the sealed inner skin (shell + both end plates + everything facing the cavity). It is restrained by bolting through the three foot holes. YOU decide the load case(s), the fixed supports (the foot bolt holes), the pressure mechanism and region, and the magnitude — declare them in spec.load_cases. Also declare the foot bolt holes in spec.features (position, axis, diameter) so the interface is re-cuttable.
